Subject: Controlled key-splitting ceremony and enclave attestation request

Hi Ben,

Quick intro — I'm Mary on the security team at Fintegral. We're progressing toward production integration and our auditors have asked for concrete artifacts around how Redwood performs customer key-splitting and any Trusted Execution Environment attestation you can provide. Specifically we need:

- A short protocol description for your split-key / M-of-N ceremony (who participates, order of operations, witness model).
- Witness logs and time-stamped transcripts for any past ceremonies (redacted as needed) or a sample transcript.
- Evidence of TEE/SGX/SEV attestation for any enclave-based sealing used during the ceremony (quotes, cert chains).
- Confirmation that no raw key material is exportable from HSMs (procedure and enforceability).
- Proof of rotation policy and automated rotation jobs for split key shares (policy docs + last rotation runbook).

Can you provide a bundle we can upload into our SIG/SOC2 evidence locker? Also let us know if a short witness call (30 mins) is required. We need this by next Wednesday (2026-09-22) to make our audit window.

Thanks,
Mary
Security Lead | Fintegral Capital

Hi Mary — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide a focused bundle for your SIG/SOC2 upload. High-level plan:

1) Deliver a protocol document (PDF) that describes our typical M-of-N ceremony (we use a 3-of-5 default for tenant master key escrow unless customers specify otherwise).
2) Provide a redacted sample transcript and timestamped witness log (we'll scrub tenant ids).
3) Include enclave attestation material: Intel SGX quotes and vendor cert chains where applicable; for Nitro/SEV we will include attestation statement artifacts.
4) Provide an HSM export controls statement and KMS access matrix extract.
5) Deliver rotation policy excerpt and a copy of the most recent rotation runbook output.

I'll assemble the artifacts and propose a 30-minute call to walk through the bundle and answer auditor questions — would 09:30 PT on Thursday (16 Sep) work? If you need earlier, we can try to accelerate.

Attached: ceremony-overview.pdf (protocol summary).

Ben Carter
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding Fintegral's request. Key asks are enumerated below. Delivery target: full bundle to customer by COB Tue 9/15 so they can ingest before their audit window (they asked for 9/22, but earlier is better).

Please see Mary’s list. Technical notes / constraints for packaging:
- Ceremony model: default 3-of-5 threshold; witnesses are internal ops personnel + customer-appointed witness when requested (we log participant IDs and TOTP session timestamps).
- HSMs (AWS CloudHSM / Azure Dedicated HSM) are used; we do not export unwrapped root key material. Provide KMS ACL snapshots and the step-by-step admin ops checklist that demonstrates non-exportability (include kms-access-matrix.csv).
- Enclave attestation: we have SGX quotes for older on-prem customers and Nitro attestation for cloud; prepare quote files and certificate chains. Ensure cert chains include issuer and timestamp.
- Rotation: capture last rotation runbook output (rotation-job-20260810.log) and the rotation policy excerpt.

Irene — can you own collating the attestation artifacts (quotes + chains + verification notes)? Neha — can you produce the witness log sample and the KMS access matrix extract and rotation runbook? Jonas — assist with redaction and legal-friendly text for export controls.

Ben
